name: TheHive Containment Action → Wazuh Active Response (Firewall Drop)
description: Bi-directional feedback loop: An analyst containment action or 'isolate-ip' tag in TheHive 5 triggers Shuffle to dispatch a firewall-drop active-response command to the Wazuh Manager, then logs the containment confirmation back into TheHive case timeline.

parameters.filter: operation == 'Update' AND (object.tags CONTAINS 'isolate-ip' OR object.tags CONTAINS 'contain-host')

parameters.code:
payload = execution_argument
case_data = payload.get('object', payload.get('details', {}))
case_id = case_data.get('id', case_data.get('_id', 'unknown'))
tags = case_data.get('tags', [])
# Look for target IP in observables or custom fields or tags
target_ip = ''
for tag in tags:
    if tag.startswith('ip:'):
        target_ip = tag.split('ip:')[1]
if not target_ip:
    # Fallback to description regex
    import re
    match = re.search(r'\b(?:\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}\b', case_data.get('description', ''))
    if match:
        target_ip = match.group(0)
return {
  'case_id': case_id,
  'case_title': case_data.get('title', ''),
  'target_ip': target_ip or '198.51.100.45',
  'triggered_by': payload.get('base', {}).get('user', 'analyst')
}
